reason.description: Required when raising the level, at most 500 characters

effectiveLevel.description: The lowest of the store's level and every cap

executionId.description: The execution the event concerns, when there is one

proposalId.description: The decision the event concerns, when there is one

code.description: A status, error code or onboarding step

resourceId.description: Proposal, connection or null for onboarding

onboardingNextStep.description: The next unfinished setup step; null when setup is done

execution.description: The person's decision and what followed; null until someone decides.

expectedRevision.description: Draft revision seen; 0 for a new draft

plannedAdSpendMinor.description: Planned ad spend for the month, minor units of the store currency

status.description: PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, APPLIED, VERIFIED, NOOP, UNKNOWN, FAILED or CONFLICT

dataUntil.description: Orders complete until (WooCommerce) or the last ad sync (Meta)

ordersCompleteUntil.description: Orders are known to be complete up to this moment

importedFrom.description: Orders are imported from this moment on

target.description: How far back the history import goes

keyHint.description: Last 4 characters of the API key

expectedVersion.description: The version seen; 0 without a mapping

verified.description: Confirm for the ad's current creative

missingComponents.description: Why the value is missing or limited

value.description: Decimal string; null when quality is UNAVAILABLE

ads.description: Effective level of ad pauses for the store (ADR-0025 point 3)

adsCaps.description: Each source that keeps ad pauses below APPROVAL_REQUIRED

reason.description: Required when stopping, at most 500 characters

stopped.description: true stops writes, false resumes them

globallyStopped.description: Operators stopped all writes; the store cannot resume them

parameters.description: Backend-set values the UI renders: adExternalId, adName, sku, variantName

units.description: Null when the period is not covered

reason.description: Why the proposal is rejected; at most 1000 characters

count.description: Orders (sales) or units (product); null when not covered

netSales.description: Null when the day is outside the imported history

deliveryUrl.description: Delivery URL to enter in WooCommerce; null until the public API address is configured
